interpretation: The Navigator can orient over every currently observed object while preserving every registered discovery target.
All selected surface claims in this benchmark have sufficient semantic verification.
Cold-start orientation does not require loading source bodies by default.
Evidence metadata breadth is still high at 16/20 identities; this benchmark does not prove low metadata growth.
non_claims: This is not proof that Navigator covers all Elyxion history.

This is not a benchmark of Global C0 internal reasoning performance.
This does not locate the existing Global C0 durable surface.
